claim.purpose: Prepare typed C-SDLC v2 acceptance cards, design, and readiness only under sprint #5595 slot 3

initial.title: [v0.91.8][WP-14] Fully accept and deploy C-SDLC v2
initial.goal: Prepare the exact typed acceptance contract for proving C-SDLC v2 as the deployed lifecycle control plane without executing acceptance in this session.
initial.required_outcome: All six issue-specific cards, retained design, declared evidence and defect inputs, validation lanes, non-claims, and stop conditions are ready for a later exact-revision acceptance execution decision.
declared_scope: C-SDLC v2 acceptance criteria and proof topology
authority_boundary: #5358 owns only its acceptance contract and future acceptance synthesis
#5548 independently owns the Gate 2 non-Git fixture repair
#5558 independently owns final typed-v2 owner-guidance repair
This preparation does not authorize acceptance execution, deployment, publication, merge, or closeout
initial.task_boundary: Generate and validate issue-local acceptance cards, design, diagram, and readiness only; stop before acceptance execution or implementation.
deliverables: Typed SIP, STP, SPP, VPP, SRP, and SOR projections for #5358
Retained C-SDLC v2 acceptance design and dependency diagram
Explicit evidence and defect inventory for #5540, #5541, #5548, and #5558
Bounded subagent review of preparation truth
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: All six #5358 cards are generated from typed values and pass structure, schema, digest, and doctor checks
AC-2: The design defines exact-revision acceptance for install/selector authority, all typed lifecycle stages, claims, validation, review, publication, shepherding, and closeout
AC-3: #5540 and #5541 are declared as closed evidence inputs without reopening or absorbing their scope
AC-4: #5548 and #5558 are declared as independently owned open acceptance blockers without editing their surfaces
AC-5: Preparation makes no acceptance, deployment, implementation, publication, merge, or closeout claim
AC-6: The typed review card contains a bounded preparation-only review scope and evidence-focused prompts
dependencies: Independent resolution and proof for open defect #5548 before acceptance can pass
Independent resolution and proof for open defect #5558 before acceptance can pass
Later integrated exact-revision C-SDLC v2 acceptance execution
non_goals: Do not execute C-SDLC v2 acceptance or deployment
Do not change C-SDLC v2 implementation, owner binaries, templates, or owner validation lanes
Do not edit shared milestone documents
Do not absorb, repair, reopen, or close #5540, #5541, #5548, or #5558
Do not use raw gh or AWS
Do not publish a PR, merge, or close #5358 in this preparation session
initial.plan_summary: Bind #5358 in its issue worktree, preserve a narrow issue-local claim, generate six typed cards and retained design, validate and doctor them, run bounded review, fix preparation-only findings, and stop at reviewed readiness.

steps.action: Initialize and bind the typed #5358 record in its dedicated worktree with issue-local protected paths
Inventory #5540, #5541, #5548, and #5558 as evidence or defect inputs without scope absorption
Validate all six cards, retained design integrity, typed issue state, and diff hygiene
Run bounded subagent review, correct preparation-only findings, and stop before acceptance execution

invariants: All lifecycle and card state mutations use independent typed v2 binaries
Tracked work occurs only in the #5358 worktree
Protected paths remain issue-local and do not include shared milestone documents
Open defect inputs remain independently owned
Planning and readiness evidence never count as acceptance proof
risks: Closed recovery evidence may be historically accurate but insufficient for current exact-revision acceptance
Open #5548 or #5558 may keep future acceptance blocked
Installed binary provenance or selector truth may drift before acceptance execution
A planning-only SOR or readiness result could be misread as completed acceptance
stop_conditions: Any protected-path collision or inability to bind exact issue ownership
Any need to edit shared milestone documents or another issue's projection
Any request to run acceptance, deploy, publish, merge, or close the issue
Any validation requiring AWS or raw gh
Any unresolved corruption in generated card or typed issue state

validation_lanes.proof_role: Check canonical typed state, all six generated cards, digests, retained design, and readiness
Check issue-local preparation artifacts for whitespace and patch hygiene

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on card corruption, claim collision, stale authority, unresolved acceptance blockers, missing exact-revision evidence, or any preparation-to-acceptance overclaim.
review_prompts: Do all six cards and the design remain preparation-only and avoid acceptance/deployment overclaim?
Are #5540 and #5541 consumed only as closed evidence inputs?
Are #5548 and #5558 retained as independently owned open blockers?
Are protected paths strictly issue-local with no shared milestone-document ownership?
Are future proof lanes exact-revision-bound, deterministic where claimed, and fail-closed?
